About the Role

Join an early-stage developer tools company as its first go-to-market hire. You will build the sales pipeline from the ground up and bring the company's AI infrastructure offering to businesses with substantial LLM API usage.

What You'll Do

  • Identify and prospect AI-native startups, agent companies, developer tooling platforms, and data teams with meaningful LLM API spend.

  • Lead discovery calls and product demonstrations, explaining pricing and the unified API integration model.

  • Manage the CRM, outbound sequences, and reporting to develop a repeatable sales playbook.

  • Share buyer feedback about pricing, model selection, and the product roadmap with company leadership.

What We're Looking For

  • Track record in outbound business development or BDR roles at early-stage B2B software companies, ideally in developer tools, infrastructure, or AI.

  • Experience selling to AI-native startups or teams with substantial LLM API usage.

  • Ability to discuss LLM APIs, model routing, and pricing credibly with engineers.

  • History of meeting or exceeding quota in commission-based outbound sales.

  • Experience as an early or first sales hire at a seed to Series B startup.

  • Comfort operating without an established brand or sales playbook.

Compensation & Benefits

Commission-heavy compensation with significant performance-based upside. Targets are designed for strong performers to earn around 100% to 110% of plan. Base compensation and equity are negotiable based on experience.

Location

Fully remote.
